items.summary: Recommendation: retain CRO opportunities as deferred handoffs under containment-only execution; create no new proposals, experiments, GitHub adoptions, telemetry, requeues, spend, or production work this cycle. Evidence: 197 approved proposals lack execution, 46 failure follow-ups remain open, 27 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven. Revenue evidence is limited to $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 with $0 site-attributed commission; ROI, margin, causal lift, and cost-to-learn remain unknown. Deferred opportunities: (1) a reusable accessible CTA/component pattern informed by shadcn/ui, whose MIT license and bounded lab checks support prototyping, but dependency, supply-chain, bundle, accessibility, and maintenance review remain required; smallest prototype is one manually copied CTA in an isolated worktree, measured by CTR after existing measurement capacity clears; (2) a source-to-markdown content workflow informed by Microsoft MarkItDown, whose MIT license and 8/8 bounded lab checks support research, but parser accuracy, prompt-injection handling, document privacy, dependency maintenance, and editorial quality remain unverified; smallest prototype is one offline conversion of a non-sensitive fixture with human review; (3) structured visual/SEO explainers informed by Mermaid, whose MIT license and static-SVG potential are promising, but sanitization, accessibility, page weight, rendering, and maintenance risks remain; smallest prototype is one manually authored isolated SVG artifact. None is ready for queueing because current CTO, CEO, CFO, Legal, Security, and Reviewer dispositions require containment-only execution and existing queue capacity is occupied.
